overview: No anticheat in the 50-repo corpus implements a check on the enchant-item packet. The corpus hits are enchantment-attribute reads (depth strider, soul speed, efficiency, knockback) used by movement, fight and block-break checks, plus packet-type registrations in Negativity and Artemis wrappers. Server-side anticheats do not watch the enchantment-table interaction, so this packet is invisible to them.
